jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Architect (LeanIX Implementation)
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Senior Enterprise Architect (LeanIX Implementation)**

**Job Location: Washington, DC (Remote)**

**Job Type: 12+ Months Contract**

**Must have: Architect, Engineer Implementation Lean IX, not as tool but End to End Implementation.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead the ground-up implementation of LeanIX, including workspace setup, meta-model configuration, fact sheet design, tagging, and subscription/ownership models.**
* Partner with the Enterprise Architecture team to determine priorities, translate EA use cases (application rationalization, technology risk/obsolescence, business capability mapping, cloud and integration architecture) into platform capabilities.
* Build, own, and continuously refine a development roadmap with clearly sequenced releases, dependencies, and value milestones.
* Define and enforce the EA data model, taxonomy, and data quality standards; establish authoritative data sources and stewardship responsibilities.
* Design and deliver integrations with ServiceNow CMDB, HR and identity systems, cloud providers, CI/CD, and other enterprise sources using LeanIX Integration API, REST/GraphQL, and the Integration Hub.
* Configure reports, dashboards, diagrams, and surveys that enable architecture decision-making and executive reporting.
* Establish EA governance and operating processes – lifecycle management, survey/attestation cycles, data quality scoring, and change control for the meta-model.
* Deliver value incrementally: release usable capability each iteration rather than waiting for a single big-bang go-live.
* Bring in industry best practices and benchmark against LeanIX reference implementations; advise stakeholders on out-of-the-box first versus customization.
* Drive adoption through enablement, training, documentation, and communities of practice across EA, IT, and business stakeholders.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, configuration baselines, and runbooks; transition the platform to support teams.
* Define and report success metrics (data completeness, application coverage, rationalization savings, risk reduction, adoption).

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years in enterprise architecture, IT asset/application portfolio management, or platform engineering, with 3+ years hands-on with SAP LeanIX.
* **Proven experience implementing LeanIX from the ground up in a large, complex enterprise environment.**
* Strong understanding of EA frameworks and practices (TOGAF, business capability modeling, application rationalization, TIME/6R analysis).
* **Hands-on experience with LeanIX meta-model configuration, fact sheets, reports, diagrams, surveys, and the Integration Hub.**
* Proficiency with REST/GraphQL APIs, JSON, and scripting (Python or JavaScript) for integrations and data automation.
* **Experience integrating LeanIX with ServiceNow CMDB and other enterprise systems of record.**
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with EA leaders and stakeholders to shape priorities and roadmaps.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and DevOps practices.
* Excellent problem-solving, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to present to senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* LeanIX certification (Associate/Professional) or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
* Experience with application rationalization or technology obsolescence programs delivering quantified savings or risk reduction.
* Exposure to IT financial management, SAM/HAM, or cloud cost transparency tooling.
* Experience in a regulated or safety-critical operating environment.

Pay: $70.00 - $75.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule

License/Certification:

* LeanIX certification (Associate/Professional) (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Head of SFU Bulk Implementation
jobs.description:
At gFiber, we believe that great internet has the power to drive innovation, strengthen communities, enable the impossible, and do all the everyday things that make all of our world go round. And the job of creating better internet is never done - so we're growing! Our team is committed to building a place where people who want to make a difference can grow their careers and find their spot to belong.

*The application window will be open until at least* ***November 1, 2026****. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.*

  

**Role Description:**

The Head of SFU Bulk Implementation will lead gFiber's SFU Bulk business. In this entrepreneurial environment, you will join a team built on highly collaborative workstreams, clear accountability, and data-driven execution.

In this role, you will help strengthen gFiber's market position and expand our reach by building an operational engine that connects strategy, sales, network planning, legal, and customer experience. Operating as the primary hub in a hub-and-spoke model, you will drive new partnerships while supporting and mentoring regional sales representatives managing local opportunities. You will collaborate directly with cross-functional leaders to establish a scalable, repeatable framework.

Ideal candidates thrive in a collaborative, flat-operational environment where proactive problem-solving, strong governance, and cross-functional partnership are essential to scaling a key growth channel.

**In this role, you'll:**

* **Own National Program Architecture & Playbooks**: Serve as the single point of national program ownership for SFU Bulk, authoring standardized developer pitch decks, Master Service Agreement (MSA) frameworks, and programmatic playbooks to establish market parity and scale.
* **Opportunity Pre-qualification & Business Case Development**: Lead the financial and operational evaluation of bulk leads using a gating qualification model while analyzing total market opportunity to include single-family, multi-family, and potentially commercial opportunities as part of the business case story.
* **Sales Enablement**: Act as the central hub routing opportunities dynamically based on decision making criteria and network status.
* **Collaborate Cross-Functionally:** Collaborate closely with Greenfield, Expansion, Strategic Network Planning and Service Delivery teams to evaluate opportunities and network connectivity options required to service the new communities.
* **Champion Product Readiness & Go-To-Market Execution**: Collaborate with Greenfield, Product, Engineering, and Regional Market Teams to execute go-to-market strategies using applicable single-family bulk or greenfield playbooks. Drive the deployment of the pre-provisioned network architecture through smooth handovers to assigned local sales contacts.
* **Conduct Competitive Intelligence & Footprint Mining**: Leverage FCC deployment filings, land data, and market intelligence to identify opportunities based on network availability, capacity, developer & HOA interest, and total market opportunity.

**At a minimum we'd like you to have:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of business development, sales leadership, or program management experience with a telecommunications / fiber operator.
* 3 years of direct experience structuring, negotiating, and closing bulk telecommunications agreements, Rights-of-Entry (ROE), or Master Service Agreements (MSAs) with HOAs, developers, and homebuilders.
* Proven track record of cross-functional leadership in matrixed environments, working closely across sales, engineering, network planning, legal, greenfield development, and finance.
* Financial acumen with experience running ROI models, calculating IRR, understanding sales incentives, and conducting capital expenditure assessments.

**It's preferred if you have:**

* Deep industry expertise in the SFU Bulk landscape and competitive operating models.
* Experience establishing property partnerships and aligning schedules directly with master-planned community developers.
* Familiarity with 3rd-party circuit procurement, leased backhaul architectures, dark fiber solutions, and telecom intake tools.
* Demonstrated ability to build a new corporate program or initiative from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.

  
  

*The US base salary for this full-time position is $140,000 - $227,000 + bonus + benefits. As pay varies by location, your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your targeted location during the hiring process.*

  

#LI-DNI

gFiber is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or Veteran status. Disclosure is voluntary, and this information will be kept confidential in compliance with Google's Candidate Privacy Policy. For more information please refer to our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy and the EEOC's "Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal" (PDF).

It's important to us to create an accessible, inclusive workplace for everyone. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our accommodations for applicants form. Our candidate accommodations team will then connect with you to confidentially discuss your options.

jobs.title: Director - Data Strategy, Enterprise Reporting and Implementation
jobs.description:
CrossCountry Consulting is the transformation partner for the Office of the CFO. As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Grounded in our Core Values, we are committed to solving today's most complex challenges while delivering a better experience for our clients, our people, and our communities. When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future.

For CFOs, CIOs, and corporate leaders to cost-effectively achieve strategic growth, real-time data insights, competitive differentiation, and complete compliance, they need a robust digital architecture that maximizes technology investments and process efficiencies. Our data systems specialists design, build, and deploy leading data, analytics, and automation programs that generate rapid ROI across the enterprise. We build the data foundation that powers finance analytics, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), and AI—helping private equity sponsors and their mid-market portfolio companies scale with confidence.

By joining our rapidly growing Data Transformation & Analytics practice you will serve as a trusted partner to our clients. You’ll bring your first-hand experience, unique perspectives, and functional knowledge to deliver tailored integrated solutions that help our clients solve today's challenges and set the foundation for future success. As a Director at CrossCountry Consulting you will be responsible for a mix of client delivery, business development, leading teams and developing junior team members, as well as serving as a member of CrossCountry’s leadership team.

### **What You'll Do:**

**Client Delivery:** Lead the development and delivery of services in the following areas:

* **Data****, AI, and technology strategy:** Advise CFOs and CIOs on AI-first data strategies and roadmaps that democratize data, leverage modern cloud platforms, strengthen data management and quality, uncover critical control needs, and prioritize high-value AI use cases.
* **Data architecture and implementation:** Serve as Solution Architect for the enterprise data foundation—scalable, secure, high-performance solutions across cloud platforms that enable multiple downstream solutions, including financial reporting, EPM, analytics, and AI, leading end-to-end ingestion, storage, transformation, and semantic modeling in a single source of truth on platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric.
* **Finance data, ERP, and EPM enablement:** Design data architectures that drive financials and enable the CFO's EPM strategy—integrating ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage Intacct) with EPM platforms (e.g., OneStream, Anaplan, Oracle EPM, Workday Adaptive Planning, Pigment) and delivering trusted data for close, consolidation, planning, forecasting, and management reporting.
* **AI platforms and agentic solutions:** Architect the data foundation for AI platforms and agentic solutions, and lead delivery of AI use cases for finance and operations—leveraging capabilities such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks Mosaic AI, and Snowflake Cortex, along with the data readiness, governance, and controls required for AI at scale.
* **Private equity and mid-market growth:** Partner with CFOs and CIOs at mid-market, PE-backed portfolio companies to assess data maturity in less mature organizations and build pragmatic, scalable data foundations that support growth, value creation, add-on acquisitions, and exit readiness.
* **Data governance, analytics, and automation:** Define and enforce governance, security, and compliance standards; optimize pipelines and ETL for performance, scalability, and cost; and design forecasting and predictive analytics models.
* Interview clients to identify root causes, define and document business requirements, and conduct current state / future state gap analyses for business and data processes.
* Develop and deliver compelling executive-level presentations and communications to CFOs and CIOs, translating complex data and AI architectures into clear business value.
* Contribute to developing and implementing firm-approved, AI-enabled solutions for clients, in accordance with company policies on data protection, intellectual property, and professional standards.
* Stay informed about emerging AI tools and techniques and collaborate with firm leadership to identify compliant opportunities to enhance client solutions and internal processes.

**Practice Leadership:** Serve as a key leader in the Data Transformation & Analytics practice by:

* Overseeing client accounts, projects, and engagements, including work plans, staffing, timelines, fee negotiations, and budgets throughout all lifecycle phases, covering strategy, goal setting, deliverables, and maintaining an integrated project plan.
* Leading business development efforts and marketing a full range of services to prospective clients, leveraging existing relationships to generate new opportunities.
* Developing timely resolutions to issues, mitigating risks, and addressing project team conflicts.
* Creating delivery methodologies and new service offerings, and contributing to go-to-market strategy and practice-specific programs.
* Evaluating emerging technologies and recommending solutions to improve clients’ data infrastructure and analytics capabilities.
* Managing teams and people by tracking and directing performance against objectives while encouraging continuous improvement and innovation.
* Mentoring and coaching team members, including providing regular feedback and annual performance reviews, and guiding project teams through complex, multi-faceted issues.

### **What You'll Bring:**

* Deep, hands-on expertise designing and implementing foundational cloud data environments on platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric, including ingestion and integration, lakehouse and warehouse architecture, data modeling, and data architecture modernization. The environment should be built once and support many solutions: AI use cases, analytics, and system integrations. Familiarity with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.
* Experience building semantic layers within the data environment, including governed metrics, business definitions, and finance data models (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, Snowflake semantic views, Databricks metric views, Fabric semantic models). These give analytics tools, EPM, and AI agents one consistent, trusted view of the business.
* Proven experience partnering with CFOs and CIOs to design data foundations that support finance analytics, agentic platforms and AI solutions, and ERP and EPM integrations.
* Experience building the data capabilities that make AI solutions work, including AI-ready data models, metadata management and data catalogs, data lineage, data quality and observability, unstructured data processing, vector search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, role-based security and access controls, and governance and monitoring for generative and agentic AI (e.g., Snowflake Cortex, Databricks Mosaic AI, Microsoft Fabric and Azure AI Foundry).
* Understanding of key finance and business processes such as Lead to Cash / Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Record to Report, and Hire to Retire.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Lean, Waterfall).
* Private Equity experience required: a track record of working with CFOs and CIOs at mid-market, PE-backed portfolio companies, including assessing the data maturity of less mature organizations and building scalable solutions that support growth, value creation, add-on acquisitions, and exit readiness.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the executive presence to present confidently to CFOs and CIOs.
* Consistent success in building and developing strong client relationships.
* Proven experience in identifying new growth and shared revenue opportunities by collaborating with sales leadership to generate new business, expand existing relationships, and increase bookings.
* Prior experience managing client and/or internal teams by guiding performance against objectives, creating an atmosphere of trust and collaboration, and encouraging continuous improvement and innovation.
* **AI Mindset:** An AI-first approach to solving client problems, with the ability to guide CFOs and CIOs on where AI creates value, and a demonstrated ability to responsibly explore and adopt firm-approved AI tools to enhance productivity and innovation.
* **Continuous Learning Mindset:** Openness to learning and applying emerging technologies including AI and automation in alignment with firm policies and client standards.
* A passion for mentoring and leading teams while efficiently implementing new ideas and initiatives.

### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
* Willingness to travel up to 30%. Travel varies based on client preferences.

***Benefits Summary***

*The CrossCountry total rewards package includes comprehensive healthcare options, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; and a 401(k) with company matching. Additionally, employees can take advantage of generous parental and maternity leave policies, technology stipends, and wellness reimbursement programs, all designed to support both professional growth and personal well-being. For detailed information about benefits at CrossCountry, please visit our dedicated benefits site:* https://www.crosscountry-consulting.com/careers/benefits/.

***Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)***

*CrossCountry provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment and believes that respect and fair treatment are critical to creating a productive and inclusive workplace.*

*As an equal opportunity employer, CrossCountry is fully committed to comply with all federal, state, and local laws and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetics, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity or expression or any other protected characteristic. The company also complies with pay transparency and labor laws applicable to all terms and conditions of employment.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Client Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**

Strive Pharmacy is a personalized compounding pharmacy built on a simple conviction: medicine should fit the patient, not the other way around. We started Strive because we believed the pharmaceutical industry was overdue for a more human approach—one that prioritizes individualized care, clinical nuance, and genuine partnership with patients and providers.

Compounding gives us the tools to do that. Every formulation we prepare is built to the specific needs of a specific person, and every interaction we have is guided by that same commitment to personalized care.

We're growing, and we're looking for people who share that conviction. If you're ready to be part of a pharmacy that takes the work seriously and the people even more seriously, we'd like to meet you.

**Mission:**

Strive exists to disrupt an industry long overdue for a more personal approach to care. We put the human element at the center of everything: every formulation, every patient interaction, every provider partnership. We're not just a compounding pharmacy. We're a team on a mission to change what personalized healthcare looks and feels like.

**Position Type:** Remote, Full time

**Position Overview:**

We are looking for a detailed-oriented and proactive Client Implementation Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be the primary guide for new clients during their onboarding journey, ensuring a seamless transition from onboarding to active product usage. You will oversee technical setup, workflow configuration, project timelines, and user training.

The ideal candidate excels at project management, possesses a solid technical aptitude, and brings exceptional communication skills to build trust and deliver value to our clients from day one.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Onboarding:
  + Project Delivery: Lead end-to-end client onboarding and technical implementations, driving projects to completion within defined timeframes and scope.
  + Milestone Tracking: Monitor go-live milestones, proactively identify risks or bottlenecks, and implement solutions to keep timelines on track.
* Technical Configuration & System Integration:
  + System Setup: Configure software/platform settings, user accounts, and workflows based on client specifications and requirements.
  + Assist with setting up products and medication templates in EMR
  + Set up user accounts for HubSpot clarifications
  + Configure web hooks via LifeFile if no integration is needed
  + Hand off partners to the Client Solutions team if an API integration is identified
* Data Migration & Support:
  + Assist clients with data mapping, import/export tasks, and initial data validation.
* Troubleshooting:
  + Diagnose and resolve technical implementation issues independently or partner with Client Solutions technical support
* Client Enablement & Relationship Management:
  + Training Delivery:
    - Conduct virtual live training sessions for admin users and end-users to drive product adoption.
  + Consultative Guidance:
    - Advise clients on best practices for prescribing to maximize compounded prescription accuracy
  + Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    - Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success Manager (CSM) teams to ensure seamless handoffs and continuous client satisfaction.
  + Prescription Success:
    - Monitor prescriptions for clinical and formatting accuracy and perform outreach when issues are identified. Monitoring period will be from first prescription until activation of account (10th prescription)

**Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum 2 years experience as a registered pharmacy technician
* Holds a PTCB certification
* Has implementation experience OR strong understanding of EMR platforms  
  Strong technical writing skills (SOPs, product changes, client documentation)
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills - comfortable with both technical teams and client stakeholders

**Work Environment:**

This position is primarily based in a remote work environment. The role requires regular periods of sitting, standing, and computer use, with occasional lifting as needed. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

**Join Us in Making an Impact:**

At Strive, the work is real and the impact is direct. Every role here contributes to a patient experience that's more personal, more attentive, and more human than what most people have come to expect from a pharmacy. Apply today and help us raise the bar.

**Benefits/ Perks:**

Strive Pharmacy offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Employer-paid healthcare coverage, effective the 1st day of the following month of your hire date
* Free Strive compounded medications for employees based on a valid patient-specific prescription from a licensed healthcare provider
* Paid time off
* Sick time
* FSA and HSA options
* Parental leave
* 401(k) with employer matching
* Life insurance
* Vision and dental insurance
* Veterinary insurance

**Culture:**

Culture isn't an afterthought at Strive. It's something we actively build. We foster a collaborative, engaging workplace where employees have opportunities to connect, celebrate, and build meaningful relationships with their colleagues. We're committed to supporting the personal and professional growth of every employee, both inside and outside the workplace.

**EEO:**

Strive Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state or local laws.

**Disclaimer\*\*\* Please do not call the pharmacy location with questions about your application or interview. A talent acquisition partner will reach out to you.**

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist I
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

**About the Operations team**  
The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

**About the Role**  
As an Implementation Support Specialist I, you'll combine your exceptional technical and communications skills to support the implementation of the Affirm solution with our growing network of retail partners. You will serve as a primary support contact for our partners' business and technical teams throughout the integration process, while working cross-functionally with Affirm's Engineering and Merchant Operations teams to help provide clients with quick solutions, troubleshoot account issues, and build internal processes that scale.

**What You'll Do**

* Provide exemplary support to merchant partners on topics including: marketing best practices, accounting workflows, implementation guidance / troubleshooting
* Resolve technical integration issues related to partners' ecommerce front-end platforms and back-end order management systems
* Identify and implement new operational processes to drive efficiency
* Develop detailed technical documentation
* Engage with internal stakeholders to define cross-functional workflows
* Provide product feedback from clients to the Product and Engineering teams to improve overall product performance and feature set

**What We Look For**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* 1-3 years of experience in relevant industry (Tech, eCommerce, SaaS) and/or similar role(s)
* Past success in a job, internship, or volunteer role that required written communication with stakeholders, customers, or partners
* Exceptional project management, communication, and technical skills to manage client engagements and internal resources
* Proven ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously, work independently and drive projects to completion with minimum guidance and high attention to detail
* Nice to have: experience working with major e-commerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, etc) or exposure to web development concepts
* Nice to have : Previous experience in the payments or ecommerce space
* Nice to have: knowledge of of HTML, Javascript, API's

**This role requires candidates to be based in the Pacific Time Zone.**

Pay Grade - D  
Equity Grade - 1  
  
**Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range.** Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.  
  
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)  
  
USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $70,000 - $90,000  
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $62,000 - $82,000

**#LI-Remote**

**Remote-first with flexibility built in**  
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

**Benefits designed for you**  
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

* Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
* Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
* Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
* Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We're committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we're happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Agency Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Agency Onboarding Specialist**

**CarePortal**

#### **Organizational Profile**

CarePortal is Care-Sharing technology that drives action for local kids and families in crisis. We believe that through the Church and Community, there can be More Than Enough care for every child, through the power of Care-Sharing and the love of Jesus. Our goal is to **scale meaningful connections** through the local church, making a lasting impact on the lives of everyone involved. We mobilize robust Care-Sharing Networks and lead with **Courage, Humility, and Excellence.**

We do this through the local Church and in collaboration with child-serving organizations, businesses, and people who care—that’s where you come in.

### **Position Summary**

### **The Agency Onboarding Specialist is responsible for guiding new agencies through onboarding to ensure they are prepared to submit high-quality, approved requests that connect children and families to meaningful support.**

### **This role focuses on efficient, high-quality activation, helping agencies understand both how to use the platform and how to clearly communicate needs in a way that leads to timely and meaningful care.**

### **While the role is supportive and relational during onboarding, it is not responsible for ongoing engagement. Success is defined by accuracy, confidence, and readiness at first submission, enabling a clean transition to the Engagement team. Network health metrics, scorecards and KPIs will be utilized to help gauge performance, however, success in this role will be measured across all of the responsibilities listed below.**

### **Your Responsibilities Include:**

**Onboarding Delivery**

* Facilitate onboarding sessions for new agencies
* Guide agencies through platform setup and request submission process

**Activation & First Submission**

* Prepare agencies to submit their first approved request
* Ensure understanding of quality standards for submissions

**Customer Experience**

* Provide clear, supportive guidance throughout onboarding
* Ensure agencies feel confident in using the platform

**Process Consistency & Improvement**

* Follow onboarding standards and playbooks
* Provide feedback to improve efficiency and clarity
* Support efforts to reduce onboarding complexity

**Coordination & Handoff**

* Ensure onboarding milestones are completed accurately
* Transition agencies to Engagement after first approved submission
* Support ecosystem balance through participation in Network Leader facilitated strategy meetings to identify, discuss and solve issues and opportunities.

### **What You Bring to the Organization:**

#### **Experience & Skills**

* Understanding of agencies, caseworkers, and the broader social services system
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to lead virtual training sessions
* Ability to guide customers through structured processes with clarity and confidence
* High attention to detail and strong follow-through
* Comfort with virtual training environments and technology platforms
* Ability to balance efficiency with a positive, supportive customer experience
* Experience with CRM systems, Microsoft Office, and virtual meeting tools preferred
* Ability to follow defined processes while identifying opportunities for improvement
* Passion for CarePortal’s mission and commitment to Courage, Humility, and Excellence

The above description is not intended to be comprehensive, but rather a focused list of priorities. Success provides the opportunity to not only build a career but also bring much-needed support and care to local children and families in crisis across the United States. Successful candidates, like all CarePortal, LLC employees, are expected to live and work consistent with CarePortal’s vision, mission, and values.

CarePortal, LLC, a subsidiary of the nonprofit organization The Global Orphan Project (GO Project), is Care-Sharing technology that drives action for local kids and families in crisis.

This platform, which brings Christian churches to the point of care for each request made on behalf of children and families, can be used to connect a diverse network of churches, child-serving agencies, businesses, and individuals who care. Learn more at www.careportal.org.

*CarePortal, LLC offers a competitive benefits package for full-time positions (30+ hours per week) including health, dental, vision and employer paid life insurance, retirement savings and generous PTO plan and a highly competitive, market-indexed compensation when compared to similar non-profit roles. Compensation is commensurate with relevant skills and experience.*

The Global Orphan Project is a 501c3 nonprofit located at 3161 Wyandotte, Kansas City, MO 64111.

CarePortal LLC associates are at-will employees.

www.goproject.org www.careportal.org

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Bankjoy is a Y Combinator and Bessemer Venture Partner backed FinTech startup. We are changing the way community banks and credit unions do business, enabling them to become tech-driven and digital first. Bankjoy provides modern digital banking products including mobile banking, online banking, online account opening, loan origination, and conversational AI. Our mission is to revolutionize banking tech infrastructure by leading digital transformation at financial institutions — big and small.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring a Senior Implementation Manager to join our Implementation team, reporting to the Director of Implementation. You'll lead complex digital banking implementations, core migrations, and product expansions from discovery through go-live and stabilization. You'll own the delivery plan, align client and vendor responsibilities, resolve blockers, and keep stakeholders informed when scope, timing, or readiness changes.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll configure and validate client environments, lead testing and launch preparation, and mentor Implementation Managers and Specialists.  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own complex client implementations from sales handoff and discovery through configuration, testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to Support and Client Success.
* Translate contracted scope into requirements, gap analysis, milestones, dependencies, owners, and acceptance criteria. Resolve gaps early and manage changes to scope and delivery commitments.

* Lead post-launch stabilization and handoff, including configuration records, open issues, owners, and support expectations. Improve core-specific guides and templates, and mentor colleagues through complex delivery work.

**What You Bring**

* Banking or fintech experience is required. You understand accounts, transfers, limits, digital banking workflows, and the operating needs of credit unions or banks.

* Experience with a core banking system or digital banking platform, including hands-on configuration, integration dependencies, and technical troubleshooting.
* A record of managing concurrent client projects, external vendors, scope changes, and delivery risks with clear ownership and current project records.

* Clear written and verbal communication, including difficult client conversations, executive updates, and explaining technical constraints without making unsupported commitments.
* Experience mentoring colleagues and improving implementation processes. Comfort working in a lean team and doing configuration, documentation, and follow-up yourself.
* Experience with Smartsheet, Jira, and Confluence or equivalents. Comfortable using company-approved AI tools for documentation and analysis while verifying outputs and following data-handling requirements.

**What You Get**

* A fast-paced and collaborative environment
* Competitive compensation
* Stock options at a well-funded startup
* We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for individuals on our base plan, with significant contributions toward all other plan options (USA).

* Microsoft Suite skills

On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.

Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We're inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world-class medicine through world-class operations. #LI-MB1

As a **Senior Surgical Growth Implementation Success Partner**, you will lead the most complex perioperative deployments in our portfolio, multi-service-line, multi-site, and executive-facing engagements where the bar for delivery, influence, and autonomy is highest. You will own the full implementation lifecycle from pre-sale collaboration through hypercare, partnering with Sales early to shape scope and set delivery expectations, and serving as the strategic advisor to perioperative executives, surgeons, schedulers, and IT teams once delivery is underway.

This role blends engagement leadership, executive stakeholder management, technical fluency, and analytics. You will operate with broad autonomy, escalating only the highest-risk or strategic matters, and you will be expected to anticipate risks before they materialize, design mitigation strategies proactively, and guide client decision-making at the executive level. Your fluency with Qventus dashboards and reporting will allow you to identify gaps, surface opportunities, and build reinforcement strategies that drive sustained adoption and ROI.

Your deep understanding of the product, perioperative operations, and EHR architecture will allow you to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement, maximizing value for clients and positively impacting healthcare operations. Join us and help revolutionize the healthcare landscape with cutting-edge technology and strategic implementation.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Partner with Sales prior to delivery handoff to shape scope, validate feasibility, and set clear delivery expectations for enterprise perioperative engagements.
* Define and manage the timeline for enterprise-wide deployment of the Qventus Periop Solution across multiple service lines and facilities.
* Lead large, complex perioperative implementations involving multiple service lines, surgeon groups, and executive stakeholders.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to perioperative leadership and the C-suite, facilitating executive-level discussions and guiding client decision-making on scope, risk, and operational strategy.
* Build and manage relationships at every level of client organizations, with a particular focus on influencing executive and senior operational stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers, Product Specialists, and Client Success Partners throughout each deployment to identify and implement solutions that maximize client value.
* Partner with operational and technical client teams to ensure periop implementation requirements and needs are met.
* Leverage deep functional periop expertise to create and sustain buy-in from core users, executives, and surgeons around workflows and tool adoption.
* Anticipate risks before they materialize, design proactive mitigation strategies, and advise internal and external leaders on resolution paths.
* Demonstrate fluency across Qventus dashboards and reporting tools to identify gaps, surface opportunities, and build reinforcement strategies that drive sustained adoption and value realization.
* Identify process improvement opportunities, implement structured approaches to close gaps, and lead change management efforts to ensure successful workflow adoption and long-term sustainability.
* Act as the primary owner of the implementation for assigned client accounts, operating with broad autonomy and accountability and escalating only the highest-risk or strategic matters.
* Articulate Qventus' value proposition and create value for customers by establishing clearly defined business outcomes.
* Create a customer base who is excited about Qventus and serves as a reference for prospective customers.
* A passion for fixing our healthcare system.

**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------

* 8+ years of project/program management experience with a comprehensive understanding of the business requirements and technical capabilities needed for an enterprise-wide SaaS implementation.
* 8+ years of professional experience working at a top healthcare consulting firm, digital health company, or health system.
* 8+ years of experience working cross-functionally with multiple teams, both internally and externally, to manage end-to-end project lifecycles and to drive project milestones to completion.
* Demonstrated experience leading large, complex implementations with executive  
  engagement.
* Proven track record collaborating with Sales or pre-sales teams to scope, validate, and hand off enterprise deployments.
* Knowledge of perioperative metrics, processes, challenges, and solutions; ability to engage in strategic and operational discussions with hospital leaders and surgeons.
* Fluency with Epic, Cerner, or comparable EHR environments, able to speak credibly to EHR architecture, integrations, and workflow implications without relying on technical SMEs.
* Project management experience with complex implementations in the provider-side healthcare setting.
* A track record of applying strong quantitative and analytical skills in prior roles, including fluent use of dashboards and reporting tools to drive adoption and reinforcement strategies.
* Prior experience managing projects for hospital systems (e.g., EHR implementations) is required.
* Skilled at understanding, documenting, and analyzing data using a variety of tools (data validation dashboards, interpreting JAVA/SQL code, complex Excel functions, etc.).
* Ability to travel on average 25% -35%.

  

**It's a Plus if You Have…**
----------------------------

* Experience writing SQL queries (highly desired).
* PMP certification.
* Experience working with clinical and/or process consultants.

Qventus values diversity in its workforce and proudly upholds the principles of Equal Opportunity Employment . We welcome all qualified applicants and ensure fair consideration for employment without discrimination based on any legally protected characteristics, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics) or any other category protected by federal, state or local law (collectively, "protected characteristics"). jobs.title: Implementation Specialist - Procurement Solutions
jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

Bluesight is seeking an experienced Implementation Specialist to lead client implementations of Procurement Solutions, which includes CostCheck, ShortageCheck and 340BCheck. CostCheck, our pharmacy purchasing and cost-savings optimization solution. CostCheck helps hospitals maximize pharmacy savings opportunities by monitoring spend against savings caps, GPO contract terms, and 340B program requirements. ShortageCheck predicts hospital and pharmacy drug shortages up to 90 days in advance, using market-wide signals — fulfillment delays, demand surges, usage trends — from over 3,250 healthcare organizations to give your team the lead time to plan ahead instead of scrambling once patient care is at risk. 340BCheck340BCheck unifies 340B data in one compliance command center, built on real HRSA audit requirements, so hospitals and grantees stay continuously audit-ready as their program grows. This is a role on the Implementation team, suited to someone who has already worked in hospital pharmacy purchasing or cost-savings optimization, and can bring that domain depth directly into how our customers configure and adopt Procurement solutions.

As a member of the team, this person will manage the most complex implementations — configuring systems to maximize potentials and fill gaps , and setting customers up on sound methodology from day one — act as a trusted advisor to customers' purchasing and pharmacy leadership, and help mentor other Implementation Specialists on purchasing-, supply- and cost-related workflows.

The ideal candidate is highly attentive to detail, comfortable talking with pharmacy buyers, purchasing directors, and finance stakeholders, and can operate in an environment that is often ambiguous and requires creativity to resolve issues.

### **Representative Duties & Responsibilities**

* Manage all aspects of Procurement Solution implementation projects, including project kick-off, software and pricing/contract configuration, go-live, and training, while maintaining project timelines.
* Configure and validate data, system outcomes, workflows, , and wholesaler/purchasing data feeds so customers' performance is tracked accurately from go-live.
* Act as the main point of contact for customers before they go live, owning all communications including weekly check-in meetings, ad hoc calls, and emails.
* Manage multiple implementation projects at once, across customers with different priorities, purchasing structures, and deadlines.
* Work as a consultative partner with customers' purchasing and pharmacy teams, advising on best practices for pharmacy cost-savings optimization, 340B compliance, and GPO/contract alignment.
* Train customer stakeholders on the CostCheck savings methodology and how to interpret savings-vs-cap performance so they're self-sufficient after go-live.
* Train customer stakeholders on the 340BCheck compliance and audit workflows within the system to provide them assistance in HRSA audits.
* Train customer stakeholders on ShortageCheck use and medication tracking.
* Act as a liaison between the customer, wholesalers/GPOs, and Bluesight's internal Clinical, Product, and Dev teams to facilitate technical and pricing configuration of the software.
* Maintain up-to-date project plans, tickets, and other project documentation so timelines stay on track and visible to leadership.
* Serve as a senior resource for the Implementation team on purchasing- and cost-related questions, helping onboard and support other Implementation Specialists.
* Travel to customer sites as needed to support rollout, meet with key stakeholders, and represent Bluesight professionally in front of customers.

### **Qualifications & Skills**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, pharmacy, healthcare management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 5+ years of professional experience, with a background aligned to hospital pharmacy purchasing, buying, procurement, or pharmacy cost-savings optimization (e.g., experience as a buyer or in a similar purchasing-facing role).
* 2+ years of project management and/or client-facing experience, ideally implementation-related.
* Strong familiarity with pharmacy cost savings programs, 340B program requirements, and group purchasing organizations (GPOs) preferred.
* Experience in the healthcare industry, ideally hospital pharmacy or health-system purchasing.
* Strong financial and data analysis skills, with the ability to assess savings performance and identify optimization opportunities during implementation.
* Ability to adapt to change, think quickly, and work independently.
* Team-player attitude and a willingness to get things done, including mentoring less-senior teammates.
* High attention to detail.
* Ability to build trusting, communicative, and results-oriented relationships with customers, including purchasing and finance stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
* ***Willingness and ability to travel within the US as needed.***

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) credentials a strong plus.
* ACE certification a strong plus.
* Excel and SQL skills a plus.
* Previous experience with EMRs/ADCs (e.g., EPIC and Cerner) or purchasing/wholesaler platforms a plus.

The standard base pay range for this role is $75,000 - $85,000 when annualized. In addition to base salary this position is also eligible for an amazing benefits package. Actual amount of salary will vary depending on position offered, experience, performance, and location.

**This position is open to applicants in the continental United States.**

**Why Bluesight?**

Bluesight’s culture is built on innovation and teamwork. There’s room to grow and opportunities to take initiative. You will partner with sharp, motivated teammates looking to disrupt a massive industry—and have fun doing it. We truly believe that where you work and what you do matters. Join us as we revolutionize the hospital pharmacy landscape!

* Competitive salary

* Time off when you need it – unlimited vacation days!

* Generous insurance coverage

* 401k program with a company match

* Fun, collaborative culture!

EOE AA M/F/VET/Disability

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, protected veteran status, disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
